  <bpmn:process id="Process_MachineInspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inspection" name="Inspection started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToEnterData</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineData" name="Enter machine type and serial number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToEnterData</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterDataToAnswerQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerQuestions" name="Answer questions and enter values">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AnswerQuestionsToPressButton</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PressButtonToCollectValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectMachineValues" name="Collect values from machine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PressButtonToCollectValues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectValuesToShowValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowCollectedValues" name="Show collected values to inspector">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectValuesToShowValues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShowValuesToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit" name="Additional questions required?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShowValuesToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsRequired</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" name="Answer additional questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsRequired</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin" name="Merge after additional questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted" name="Inspection completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToEnterData" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inspection" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineData"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PressButtonToCollectValues" sourceRef="Task_PressMeasurementButton" targetRef="Task_CollectMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectValuesToShowValues" sourceRef="Task_CollectMachineValues" targetRef="Task_ShowCollectedValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShowValuesToSplit" sourceRef="Task_ShowCollectedValues" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestionsRequired" name="Results require additional questions" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit" targetRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No additional questions" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestionsToJoin" sourceRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin"/>

rules.instruction: When The description says that the user must enter several separate identifying items (for example a type and then a serial number) before the main work can begin, so that each item is stated as its own entry.: Model each separately stated user entry as its own bpmn:userTask, in the order the description gives them, and place these entry tasks before the first automated step that depends on them. Do not merge several distinct entries into one user task.
rules.situation: The description says that the user must enter several separate identifying items (for example a type and then a serial number) before the main work can begin, so that each item is stated as its own entry.

rules.instruction: When the description states, in one sentence, that an actor selects or provides several distinct kinds of information (for example several choices, or personal data together with payment data) after a single verb, and each kind is a separate input the actor supplies: Model each distinct kind of input as its own task, in the order the description states them, connected by sequence flows. Do not combine them into one task whose label lists all the items. Keep each task label to the verb and its single main object, using the description's own words.
rules.situation: The description states, in one sentence, two or more distinct data items that a participant enters before a later step (for example a type and an identifier, joined by 'and' after a single entering verb), so each item is a separate input.

rules.instruction: When the description lists, in one bullet item, a person's action followed by two or more automatic software actions (such as collecting data from an external device and presenting it), and the bullet states no order between those software actions: Model the automatic software actions as bpmn:serviceTasks, not userTasks. Place a parallel gateway before them to fork the flow and a matching parallel gateway after them to join the flow again before the process continues. Do not chain the automatic actions in sequence unless the description orders them.
rules.situation: the description lists, in one bullet item, a person's action followed by two or more automatic software actions (such as collecting data from an external device and presenting it), and the bullet states no order between those software actions

rules.instruction: When the description says a person presses a button, after which software automatically collects data from equipment and presents the collected data to that same person: Model the button press as its own bpmn:userTask, labeled with the verb and object the description uses for the press. Model the automatic collection of data from the equipment as a separate bpmn:serviceTask, placed directly after the press, and model the presentation of the collected data as a further bpmn:serviceTask in the order the description gives. Do not merge the press, the collection and the presentation into one task, and do not replace the press or the presentation with a generic label.
rules.situation: the description says a person presses a button, after which software automatically collects data from equipment and presents the collected data to that same person

rules.instruction: When the description states that after the user enters identifying data for a device, the system itself establishes contact with that device and then automatically collects data from it, with the collected data shown to the user afterwards: Model the step that establishes the link to the device as its own bpmn:serviceTask, placed after the identifying entries and before the automatic collection. Model the automatic collection and the later display of the collected data as further separate bpmn:serviceTasks in the order the description gives. Do not merge these automatic steps into adjacent bpmn:userTasks, and do not omit the link step when the description implies that the device must be reached before its data can be collected.

promoted.trigger: the description states that after a participant enters identifying information for an external entity, the system itself establishes a connection to that entity and then automatically retrieves information from it, which is presented to the participant afterwards
promoted.instruction: Model the step that establishes the connection to the external entity as its own bpmn:serviceTask, placed after the identifying entries and before the automatic retrieval. Model the automatic retrieval and the later presentation of the retrieved information as further separate bpmn:serviceTasks in the order the description gives. Do not merge these automatic steps into adjacent bpmn:userTasks, and do not omit the connection step when the description implies that the external entity must be reached before its information can be retrieved.
